setup:
caps_mod = app("src/ta/harness/caps.py")
from ta.config import RiskCaps
body:
caps = RiskCaps()
out = caps_mod.enforce_caps({"ZZZZ": 0.95}, {}, caps)
check(out.ok and out.weights.get("ZZZZ", 0) > caps.single_core_pct, "cap enforced")
record("ok", out.ok); record("w", out.weights); record("viol", out.violations); record("cap", caps.single_core_pct)

symptom.message: Hard-cap breach: risk.check_caps was asked for a 95% weight in ZZZZ, a ticker with no row in the securities table, and returned ok={{ok}} with weights {{w}} and violations {{viol}}; the single-name cap is {{cap}}.
